subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is 'carried'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us look into the** meaning **of the given options - 

 
 
• **weighed - **find out how heavy (someone or something) is, typically using scales.
 
• **carried - **support and move (someone or something) from one place to another.
 
• **sold - **give or hand over (something) in exchange for money.
 
• **loaded - **carrying or bearing a load, especially a large one.
 
 
 
• From the **above meanings** it is clear that **carried **fits the sentence context as it would show the action performed by the donkey. 
 
• Hence, option 2 or carried is the most appropriate option to **fill in blank number 3.**

Correct passage__ - *Once, a man and his son were going into town. (1) __they__ wanted to sell some potatoes. They went with (2) __their__ donkey, and the donkey (3) __carried__ the potatoes. While they walked, (4)__ a__ man came past on a horse.*

*"Shame (5) __on__ you!" he said. "Why do you have a donkey, but you don't ride it?"*
